column4: Acceptance Criteria

column3: As a user I want to screenshot a TikTok or Instagram post so that the app extracts the venue and saves it to my board
column4: Screenshot is parsed by AI > venue name and category extracted > Google Places enriches with photo and rating and address > venue appears in preview > user picks a list > venue saved

column3: As a user I want to paste a TikTok or Instagram link so that the venue is auto-detected and saved
column4: Link is pasted > source auto-detected > caption parsed > venue enriched > preview shown > saved to chosen list

column3: As a user I want to search for a venue by name so that I can add it manually
column4: User types venue name > Google Places autocompletes > photo and rating and address populated > saved to chosen list

column3: As a user I want to continue browsing while a screenshot is processing so I'm not stuck waiting
column4: Continue browsing button appears during loading > user navigates away > teal notification banner appears when done > tapping it opens the preview

column3: As a user I want to choose which list to save venues to so that my saves are organised
column4: Pinterest-style list picker opens > shows existing lists with thumbnails > auto-sort option > create new list option > tapping a list saves immediately

column3: As a user I want to be prompted to add a saved venue to my calendar so I can plan when to visit
column4: After saving > calendar prompt appears > options: Pick a date or Add to Google Calendar or Not now

column3: As a user I want to see personalised venue recommendations so I discover places that match my taste
column4: Discover tab shows trending venues and Because you like section based on saved categories > venues have photo and area and price and rating

column3: As a user I want to swipe through venues Tinder-style so I can quickly save or skip places
column4: Swipe deck opens > drag right to save or left to skip > haptic feedback > taste match badge shows > tap to flip for details > undo button

column3: As a user I want to see full details of a venue so I can decide whether to visit
column4: Full-screen view with photo carousel > name and area and rating and price > description > vibe tags > address > Book and Directions and Schedule and Share buttons

column3: As a user I want to mark a venue as visited and rate it so I can track where I've been
column4: Been here toggle persists visit date > 1-5 star rating saves to database > community average shown

column3: As a user I want to write personal notes on a venue so I remember what to order or who to bring
column4: Notes textarea auto-saves on blur > persists across sessions > placeholder suggests what to write

column3: As a user I want to generate an AI itinerary from my saved venues so I get a ready-made evening plan
column4: 5-step quiz (vibes > area > budget > group > energy) > AI generates sequenced stops with travel times > each stop has time and name and type and price

column3: As a user I want to swap a stop in my plan so I can customise the itinerary
column4: Swap button on stop card > alternative venue replaces it > travel times recalculated > can cycle through up to 3 alternatives

column3: As a user I want to share my plan with friends so we can coordinate
column4: Share button > link generated > send via WhatsApp or copy link > friend sees read-only plan

column3: As a user I want a bar crawl mode so I get a pub or cocktail crawl itinerary
column4: Bar crawl quiz (6 questions) > all stops are bars or pubs > within walking distance > matches chosen vibe and budget

column3: As a user I want to browse my saved venues organised into lists so I can find them easily
column4: Saves tab shows folder cards with photo collages > tap to see large venue cards inside > swipe right to go back

column3: As a user I want to create and rename and delete lists so I can organise my saves
column4: + New list button > rename via 3-dot menu > delete via 3-dot menu with confirmation > share via share icon

column3: As a user I want to see all my saved venues on a map so I can find places near me
column4: Map view with clustered pins > category filter chips at top > tap pin for venue card > list of venues below map

column3: As a user I want to filter the map by category so I only see the type of venue I'm looking for
column4: Category chips filter both map pins and the venue list below > tapping a chip toggles the filter

column3: As a user I want to connect with friends by sharing a code so we can see each other's saves
column4: 4-letter friend code shown on profile > enter friend's code to connect > both users see each other's saves

column3: As a user I want to view a friend's saved venues so I can get inspiration from their recommendations
column4: Tap friend > see their folders and spots > save any spot to my own board

column3: As a user I want to create shared bucket lists with friends so we can plan together
column4: Create list with name and emoji > add spots from saves or manually or screenshot > invite friends > tick off visited items with celebration

column3: As a user I want to update my profile photo so friends can recognise me
column4: Tap avatar > pick photo > full-screen preview > crop to circle > upload > updates everywhere

column3: As a user I want to set my taste preferences so the app recommends better venues
column4: Preferences screen with toggleable chips > selections saved > Discover tab adjusts recommendations

column3: As a new user I want a guided setup so I can personalise the app from the start
column4: 5-step wizard: name > interests > taste > this-or-that photo picks > seed board with liked venues

column3: As a user I want to see my scheduled visits on a calendar so I can plan my week
column4: Month view with coloured dots > tap a day to see events > add spots to dates > build plans from calendar

column3: As a user I want to share a venue with friends outside the app so I can recommend places
column4: Share button uses native share sheet on mobile > falls back to clipboard copy > includes name and area and Maps link
